latest_release.name: v1.8.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

### 🎉 New Features
* Added recorded flow support for headless authentication by @Mzack9999 in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1712
* Added chrome-headless-shell for headless crawls by @Mzack9999 in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1759
* Added BrowserContextID to the hybrid crawler by @sullo in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1839
* Added optional per-page BeforeNavigate / AfterLoad hooks to the hybrid engine by @sullo in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1853

### 🐞 Bug Fixes
* Fixed hybrid onclick-click simulation not being disableable by @sullo in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1749
* Fixed hybrid ignoring Options.Proxy when attaching to a remote browser by @sullo in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1751
* Fixed hybrid leaking CDP websocket reader goroutines by @sullo in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1755
* Fixed regex endpoint scraping on non-textual response bodies by @sullo in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1768
* Fixed hybrid ignoring -proxy for loopback targets by @sullo in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1769
* Fixed hybrid closing a browser katana didn't launch by @dogancanbakir in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1823
* Fixed hybrid page not bound to the crawl context by @dogancanbakir in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1824
* Fixed hybrid panic when TimeStable is 0 by @dogancanbakir in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1826
* Fixed -cwu closing the user's existing Chrome tabs by @raltheo in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1848
* Fixed headless hang when a discarded page leaked a browser pool slot by @raltheo in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1850
* Fixed invalid CSS selectors for element ids by @raltheo in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1851
* Fixed area href not crawled and frame src parsed twice by @CalvinTjoaquinn in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1861

## New Contributors
* @sullo made their first contribution in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1749
* @raltheo made their first contribution in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1848
* @CalvinTjoaquinn made their first contribution in https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/pull/1861

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/projectdiscovery/katana/compare/v1.7.0...v1.8.0
